PARAMS = {
    "Wnb":   (0.6, 0.42, 3.0),     # vctrl bias NMOS width (L=Lb)
    "Lb":    (1.0, 0.3, 2.0),      # starving/bias length
    "Wpb":   (4.0, 1.0, 16.0),     # PMOS diode width (L=Lb)
    "kst":   (1.5, 0.7, 4.0),      # starving mirror ratio
    "Wpi":   (1.0, 0.42, 3.0),     # ring inverter PMOS width (L=0.15)
    "Wni":   (0.42, 0.42, 1.5),    # ring inverter NMOS width
    "kb1":   (2.0, 1.0, 5.0),      # first buffer upsizing
    "kb2":   (2.0, 1.0, 6.0),      # output buffer upsizing
    "Cff":   (15e-15, 3e-15, 60e-15),  # edge-boost feed-forward cap
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    n = Netlist("vctrl vout vdd vss")
    Lb = p["Lb"]; Lm = 0.15
    # --- bias: vctrl -> NMOS current -> PMOS diode (pb)
    n.M("MNB", "pb", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", p["Wnb"], Lb)
    n.M("MPB", "pb", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wpb"], Lb)
    Wns = max(0.42, p["Wnb"] * p["kst"])
    Wps = max(0.42, p["Wpb"] * p["kst"])
    # --- 3-stage current-starved ring
    nodes = ["x1", "x2", "x3"]
    for i in range(3):
        inp = nodes[i - 1]; out = nodes[i]
        n.M(f"MPS{i}", f"sp{i}", "pb", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", Wps, Lb)
        n.M(f"MP{i}", out, inp, f"sp{i}", "vdd", "pfet", p["Wpi"], Lm)
        n.M(f"MN{i}", out, inp, f"sn{i}", "vss", "nfet", p["Wni"], Lm)
        n.M(f"MNS{i}", f"sn{i}", "vctrl", "vss", "vss", "nfet", Wns, Lb)
    # --- buffer 1 (restores fast rail-to-rail edge)
    k1 = p["kb1"]
    n.M("MB1P", "b1", "x3", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0 * 0.42 * k1, Lm)
    n.M("MB1N", "b1", "x3", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42 * k1, Lm)
    # --- output buffer with feed-forward cap (overshoot past rails)
    k2 = p["kb2"]
    n.M("MB2P", "vout", "b1", "vdd", "vdd", "pfet", 2.0 * 0.42 * k2, Lm)
    n.M("MB2N", "vout", "b1", "vss", "vss", "nfet", 0.42 * k2, Lm)
    n.C("CFF", "b1", "vout", p["Cff"])

    # --- first-order predictions
    vmid = 0.5 * sum(spec.get("vctrl_range", [0.7, 1.4]))
    try:
        op = lut.op("n", p["Wnb"], Lb, vmid, 0.6)
        ib = op["Id"]
    except Exception:
        ib = 11e-6
    ist = ib * p["kst"]
    Cnode = (p["Wpi"] + p["Wni"]) * Lm * 1.0e-14 * 1e2 * 0.1 + 3e-15 + (p["Wpi"] + p["Wni"]) * 1.2e-15
    Cnode += (3 * 0.42 * k1) * Lm * 1e-14 / 3
    td = Cnode * 0.9 / max(ist, 1e-9)
    f_mid = 1.0 / (6 * td)
    vdd = 1.8
    Cbuf = 3 * 0.42 * k1 * 1.5e-15 + 3 * 0.42 * k2 * 1.5e-15 + 2 * p["Cff"] + 15e-15
    p_dyn = (3 * Cnode + Cbuf) * vdd**2 * f_mid * 1.3
    power = ib * vdd + p_dyn
    return n, {"f_mid": f_mid, "swing": 1.83, "power": power}
